description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 6 adult bikes- 6-passenger low-speed vehicle- Carriage house- Parking for 6 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover the luxury of slow-paced, leisurely living at Dolce Far Niente in Seagrove Beach! This stunning Main House and Carriage House collectively accommodate 18 guests, with 6 total bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms. Indulge in days of carefree coastal fun—paddleboarding, kayaking, and searching for souvenirs in local shops. Seagrove Beach’s quintessential beach town setting provides the best of 30A, including generationally beloved eateries and boundless natural beauty. With gorgeous outdoor spaces designed for enjoying the balmy coastal weather, and the sugar-white sand beach and bright turquoise Gulf nearby only a 5-minute stroll down the road, this home has everything guests need for an unforgettable escape.Crafted in the modern Mediterranean style, the Main House balances dramatic architectural details with stylish furnishings and warm, natural textures to create a serene sanctuary for unwinding with loved ones. On the first level, guests will find a gourmet kitchen, refined living spaces, and a lavish primary bedroom with a plush king bed—all the property’s bedrooms feature a private bathroom.Venture upstairs to find additional sleeping accommodations, beginning with an inviting primary bedroom with a king bed. The 2 guest bedrooms feature 1 king bed and 2 queen beds, respectively. A bunk room completes the level with 3 twin-over-twin beds.Perfect for couples or small families seeking privacy, the Carriage House includes a kitchen, a living space, and a guest bedroom with a king bed.Sample the sweet life of Seagrove Beach at Dolce Far Niente. Beach access is at the end of Pelayo Avenue, and guests enjoy easy exploration with 6 parking spots—plus 6 complimentary bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. Book today and start planning a fabulous Emerald Coast getaway.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private bathroom with Soaking Tub/Shower Separate-Guest Bedroom: 3 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Living Area: Kitchen, and Living Room

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Seagrove Beach "Dolce Far Niente" 137 Pelayo Avenue Santa Rosa Beach, Florida Bedrooms 6 Beds 12 Sleeps 18 Full Baths 6 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 6 adult bikes - 6-passenger low-speed vehicle - Carriage house - Parking for 6 vehicles - Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Discover the luxury of slow-paced, leisurely living at Dolce Far Niente in Seagrove Beach! This stunning Main House and Carriage House collectively accommodate 18 guests, with 6 total bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms. Indulge in days of carefree coastal fun—paddleboarding, kayaking, and searching for souvenirs in local shops. Seagrove Beach’s quintessential beach town setting provides the best of 30A, including generationally beloved eateries and boundless natural beauty. With gorgeous outdoor spaces designed for enjoying the balmy coastal weather, and the sugar-white sand beach and bright turquoise Gulf nearby only a 5-minute stroll down the road, this home has everything guests need for an unforgettable escape. Crafted in the modern Mediterranean style, the Main House balances dramatic architectural details with stylish furnishings and warm, natural textures to create a serene sanctuary for unwinding with loved ones. On the first level, guests will find a gourmet kitchen, refined living spaces, and a lavish primary bedroom with a plush king bed—all the property’s bedrooms feature a private bathroom. Venture upstairs to find additional sleeping accommodations, beginning with an inviting primary bedroom with a king bed. The 2 guest bedrooms feature 1 king bed and 2 queen beds, respectively. A bunk room completes the level with 3 twin-over-twin beds. Perfect for couples or small families seeking privacy, the Carriage House includes a kitchen, a living space, and a guest bedroom with a king bed. Sample the sweet life of Seagrove Beach at Dolce Far Niente. Beach access is at the end of Pelayo Avenue, and guests enjoy easy exploration with 6 parking spots—plus 6 complimentary bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. Book today and start planning a fabulous Emerald Coast getaway.
